visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) On a sunlit sidewalk lined with lush green trees, a young man in a white school uniform, black shorts, and glasses is being interviewed by a woman wearing a beige jacket, denim jeans, and a blue baseball cap. She holds a black microphone toward him while another woman in a red cap stands in the foreground, partially obscuring the view. Parked white cars and a passing public bus are visible in the background. (2) The man in the school uniform appears emotionally overwhelmed, looking upward as the camera zooms slightly on his face. Large yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The scene then transitions into a high-energy montage featuring a man with long hair and a black cap rapping in a dimly lit studio with vibrant green and pink neon light tubes. He performs aggressive hand gestures while holding a microphone. (3) The montage continues with shots of the rapper in different environments, including a mirrored outdoor building facade and a staircase. He wears various black street-style outfits and occasionally uses a white megaphone. Interspersed are close-up shots of a smartphone displaying a timer and a cartoon character (Open-chan) floating in the sky against a bright background. (4) The rapper, now wearing a pink wig and a party hat, celebrates in front of a 7-Eleven store. He blows a party horn, holds purple pom-poms, and presents a small cake with a lit candle to the camera. Inside the convenience store, he raps amidst refrigerated drink shelves. The video concludes with close-up shots of two miniature Nissan GT-R model cars in white and green cases, followed by a credit overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking at a moderate conversational pace in an outdoor environment with faint urban ambient noise. (2) A female voice interjects briefly, followed by a sharp stinger sound effect and a sudden burst of loud cheering and laughter. A high-tempo, aggressive rock/phonk musical track with a heavy, distorted bassline and driving percussion immediately swells. (3) Energetic male rap vocals start with a fast speech rate and high vocal arousal. The music remains dominant with clear, sharp drum hits and a consistent rhythmic pulse. (4) Stylized transition whooshes and impact sound effects punctuate the rap verses as the track maintains high intensity. (5) During a melodic refrain, the vocal style shifts slightly towards a rhythmic singing tone, accompanied by the sound of a party horn blowing. The track then proceeds through several rapid cuts and percussive transitions, ending with a final fading instrumental and a clear stinger SFX as the brand logo appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Musical Performance -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic, meme-inspired rap parody to promote a 7-Eleven birthday event and a limited-edition collaboration featuring Nissan GT-R model car collectibles. It leverages high-energy editing and a 'flexing' narrative to build excitement for the product release.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, mention of pricing, and clear inclusion of the 7-Eleven brand name and logo throughout the promotional song.
